concerns.text: FR-007 requires an aggregated McNemar test across all tasks. The task list replaces this with a Cochran‑Mantel‑Haenszel (CMH) test and only provides a placeholder `run_mcnemar_test` function without any verification step, thereby weakening the functional requirement and dropping the mandated acceptance criterion.

SC-001 specifies that the report must include the absolute pass@1 drop (≥5%) alongside the Bonferroni‑corrected p‑value. The verification for T021 only checks for section headings and length, not that the required metric is computed or presented, so the success criterion is untestable.
